Institutional Footprint — How to Read It

🏦

Put/Call OI Ratio

Total put open interest ÷ total call open interest, across all expiries.

  • ≥ 1.5 — heavy institutional put hedging, strong floor support
  • 1.0 – 1.5 — moderate put positioning, supportive
  • < 1.0 — call-heavy, bullish lean, less downside hedge
🧱

Whale Put Wall

The strike with the highest total PUT open interest — the institutional "cushion" price.

  • Strike ≤ Whale Put Wall → selling alongside institutions ✓
  • Strike > Whale Put Wall → less institutional support below you
🚧

Whale Call Wall

The strike with the highest total CALL open interest — the institutional resistance ceiling.

  • Price < Call Wall → range-bound, safer for CSP ✓
  • Price > Call Wall → resistance broken, less predictable
✅

Ideal CSP setup

All three institutional signals aligned in your favour:

  • Put/Call OI ratio ≥ 1.5
  • Strike ≤ Whale Put Wall
  • Current price < Whale Call Wall

4Hit rate, week 1 to week 6

A pick is checked every 7 days after day 1 (or at expiry if that comes first). Above strike = stock still above the strike. ≥ 50% kept = the put could be bought back for half the premium or less. All SELL CSP is every SELL CSP contract the screener flagged on any scan, measured the same way: the Top-20 cut has to beat simply selling any qualifying put. Tap a week row to focus on it.

5Dollar result, week 1 to week 6

The same picks in dollars: what selling one contract of every pick would show if closed at that week (premium received minus the cost to buy the put back).

SELL TO OPEN — selling a cash-secured put obligates you to BUY 100 shares per contract at the strike price if assigned. The full cash (strike × 100 × contracts) must sit in your brokerage account while the position is open.

Probability of expiring worthless = 1 − |Delta| (Black–Scholes approximation). Real probability depends on market moves and implied-volatility changes.

Data source: Yahoo Finance (unofficial, ~15–20 min delayed) via the CSP Screener Suite (csp_screener.py → csp_ranker.py). Always verify live prices and open interest in your broker before placing any trade, and check the earnings calendar — a stock reporting before expiry can gap down and force assignment at a loss.

Nothing in this dashboard is financial advice. This is a personal analytics tool for reviewing your own screener output.
